FN-5VR9B3M-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 462
Committee: Military and Veterans Affairs Sponsor: Representative TaShina Morris
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/31/2025
House Bill 462 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama
Department of Public Health to adopt rules to accept as credit toward the qualifications for
emergency medical services personnel licensure for certain training or education acquired in
military service, but would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
